name: Mize
description: Logs every job application and shows which employers actually reply.
notes: When a new Mize is out, a button appears at the foot of the sidebar: click to download, then Restart to update
Restoring a backup keeps your logged shifts, and jobs not rated yet no longer say 'No experience needed'
Saved searches check for new jobs every day without using your AI searches; they are rated when you open them
